title: Polylogarithmic Chabauty--Kim loci over number fields
summary: We study polylogarithmic Chabauty--Kim loci for $S$-integral points on $\mathbb{P}^1\smallsetminus\{0,1,\infty\}$ over number fields. We compare motivic and étale Selmer schemes, describe Galois actions on Selmer schemes and period rings, and give an explicit formula for the localisation map on the polylogarithmic Selmer scheme. For imaginary and real quadratic fields, we derive equations and determine several polylogarithmic and full Chabauty--Kim loci and show that Kim's Conjecture holds in several new cases.
